response.rationale: The item is final_sale == True (intimates), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. The standard 30-day window rule (RET-007) requires final_sale == False, so it does not apply. The defective exception (RET-020) also requires final_sale == False and defective is not True, so it does not apply.
